evidence_summary.stage6_1_finding: Strong Spearman rank correlation (rho = +0.7685) between MEPS SW_IN ensemble spread and absolute forecast error magnitude |y - pred|.
evidence_summary.stage6_1_experiment_result: Direct inclusion of meps_std_SW_IN in GBDT degraded EVEN-CV MAE by +0.0457 W/m2 and failed all 4 decision gates.
evidence_summary.scientific_assessment: Correlation with absolute error magnitude alone is insufficient to justify a new forecasting experiment. Re-packaging meps_std_SW_IN via conditioning, regime-gating, or sample-weighting is classified as an architectural variation of a previously tested signal.

scientific_boundary.what_is_established: The Stage 6.1 direct-use formulation did not improve the locked evaluation objective (MAE), and correlation alone is insufficient to justify Stage 8.12.
scientific_boundary.what_is_not_established: That ensemble spread has zero physical or predictive value under all possible formulations.
